steps.label: VAR_BLUSHES starts at nought
3.1 room four: Dorcas is delighted, and nothing improper has been said
and room four is what the potboy and the travellers read
looking at the board twice is one moment, not two
3.2 the register: a document does not know what it is saying
and reading it again does not count it again
3.2 Sops: the Forty-Second, his wife, and a bun
and he has a fourth page, so the bit stops rather than loops
3.6 the travellers: peasants, unacquainted, holding hands
and the pair of them are marked as having said it
asking the OTHER one is the same joke, and does not count twice - which a self switch could not have known
nor does going back to the first one
3.7 Perpetua's tale is heard, and one command at the end of it says so
and the tale still counts as a tale, exactly as it did before
Perpetua herself is not one of the moments
3.7 Gerald, and that is all that is being said about Gerald
and the page turns its own condition off, so it cannot shadow the feud
ask again and Dorcas is back to selling beds, at 25, as she always was

steps.comment: No Escape here. The advance above leaves the interpreter idle on the map, so Escape has nothing to close and opens the *menu* instead - and every goto after it then waits forever for a transfer that Scene_Menu will never perform. Assert the scene instead, which turns that mistake into a failed check rather than a hung run.
steps.label: still on the map, and not in a menu somebody opened by accident

steps.comment: Not start(): with Piper unrecruited the board has no page that qualifies, so _pageIndex is -1 and start() throws on an undefined list. That is exactly the state being asserted - the minutes are not on the wall yet - so assert it directly.
steps.label: 3.3 the minutes are not there at all until Piper has been recruited
and nothing about them has been counted
3.3 verse seven: struck, and verse eight, and a word
and the ending knows the ballad happened
and reading the minutes twice is one moment
3.5 without a field medic the washstand is a washstand
3.5 with one, it is four separate systems, and she is being kind
and the towel has been refolded, which is the whole of the second page
3.4 without the cataloguer a nest is a nest
3.4 the crest is a display structure, and that is why there are nine of them
and the nest is where you put it back
3.4 the shed skin: it goes in the monograph
3.4 gravid, and the single most normal thing in this cave

steps.comment: gap 30, not the default 12. keyDown + 4 frames + keyUp + 12 is shorter than a step on the world map, so the second press can arrive while the first one is still moving and Game_Player.moveByInput drops it. The walk then stops one square short and every check after it is wrong by one tile.

steps.label: 3.8 the second notice is walked onto, one square short of the plaque

steps.comment: The advance comes BEFORE the counter check, not after it. This is a player-touch event, so walking on starts its list and stops there with two windows of text on the screen - and story.blush() is the last command in that list, after both of them. Checking the counter first reads the value from before the notice was finished.

steps.label: 3.8 theory seven has been removed at the request of the parish AND THE FAMILY
and walking over it again does not count again - a tile you cross twice is still one notice
the retrofit is eleven moments, and not one of them says the thing
